canonicalization.rule: Library catalogue records and later lawful manifestations of this title are manifestations of the same 1992 work unless edition/content differences are demonstrated; do not count mirrors or catalogue copies as independent corroboration.
canonicalization.reason: Runs381-588 remain outside the last deterministic controlled-ledger reconciliation.

requirements: obtain a lawful authoritative full-text manifestation
hash and record manifestation/version where permitted
inspect preface/methodology for dialect, locality, consultants and corpus provenance
create exact page/section/example locators only for directly supported propositions
separate Osada's observations/data from inherited/cited-source material
verify file-level reuse terms before storing or redistributing binary content

uncertainty: Catalogue metadata verifies bibliographic identity but not proposition-level content.
No claim is made here that the work is openly licensed or redistributable.
No linguistic or cultural proposition is promoted from catalogue metadata alone.
